purpose: Editorial evidence assessment of readiness in the existing eight milestones. Not measured completion, statistical confidence, AAA probability or a global average.
scope_policy: Existing Rain City/Salmon opening and current kit only; PRD and buildout ledger remain authoritative. No additional mission, boss or system is authorized by this rubric.

general_anchors.0: No applicable valid evidence, not performed, or failed target; record which, never infer product is bad from unknown. Plans/prompts/reports alone earn no delivered-outcome credit.
general_anchors.25: Meaningful source/component/isolated technical contract or bounded authored pilot supported; human-only row requires actual limited named human check.
general_anchors.50: Representative normal current-package behavior in declared pilot scope with source/observer limits; human-only row requires actual representative named review. Partial coverage is explicit.
general_anchors.75: Frozen dimension target substantially proven in its entire declared scope, clean actual integration/appropriate ordinary controls and independent validation; unresolved blocker in that same target prevents75. For narrow pipeline rows scope stays narrow.
general_anchors.100: Every frozen dimension acceptance condition and applicable named human/physical/release approval met, independent evidence review and no unresolved critical defect in that scope. Means approved scoped target, not perfection or permanent safety.

confidence_policy.human_quality: low until named human/device evidence; these labels are editorial judgments, not statistical intervals.
confidence_policy.current: medium calibration and scoped technical support; high in known blocker/dependency status; low in unperformed experiential quality.

human_credit_policy: Every human-only dimension above zero requires a named reviewer, hashed approval record, linked evidence identity and declared actual scope. No agent, screenshot or simulated device substitutes.
unsupported_credit_policy: Plans, unperformed work, invalid runs and unsupported claims earn zero outcome credit. Partial valid component work may earn credit only for its explicit narrower scope; blockers remain caps.
acceptance_policy: Acceptance is a separately evidenced decision, never derived from score. V6/V7 factual acceptance requires named approval plus accepted dependencies; scope approval is not permission to publish.
history_policy: Append-only canonical-JSON SHA256 parent chain; changing weights, targets, anchors or cap policy requires a new rubric version retaining prior rubric and records. Dynamic observed caps and scores live only in history.

stage_anchors.75: All declared ordinary routes, OS recovery, sustained native/Web and rendered budgets supported; no critical defect
stage_anchors.100: Applicable physical-device/accessibility/reliability approvals and clean release identity accepted
